item.title: Dead looking Hawthorn Tree, 19th August
item.description:
Public Tree GT100 066716 Spring 2026 this tree was healthy and produced good foliage and pink blossom. In May it turned brown over a two week period and looked dead. I’ve been advised to constantly feed it fertiliser and keep it watered as it may have a blockage and could survive- all this I have done and you can see in the photo there is new growth on the lower trunk. I would appreciate an expert from the park getting involved to inspect and advise on any additional action/treatment I can take to save this tree.
